Submit governance changes to [GCFPE-MGMT-10 — Manage an Ecosystem Change — 100926.1](https://app.notion.com/p/3f74590a05eb81b69bd8c27106f7a59d), which runs one Modification through ANALYZE, PLAN and EXECUTE with the real affected area, expected and actual result, and evidence, and returns every result to Nathan. The final [CL-40 — 102726.1](@SUCC_URL:CL-40) scan uses its real closure intake and returns terminally to the Product Owner. Navigation grants no execution authority and cannot restart completed work or invoke manual abort. How a change to this ecosystem is made routine — the five-step lifecycle, the defect-class catalogue, the standing instruments and the definition of done — is docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/ecosystem-change-management.md, which is normative. Skill changes follow docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/skill-packaging-and-delivery.md: no skill change is trusted until a party that did not author it has validated it, and a verdict is scoped to exact bytes and does not carry. Post-flight follows docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/postflight-procedure.md. Preserve one continuing maintenance owner, bounded impact dispositions for every member, actual validation and publication evidence, and the existing error log. Selection follows successful candidate checks; complete selected-state readback and independent audit precede archival. Publication alone does not establish runtime success. ## Historical change-management process — 100926.1
